features.quote: minimize exposure, don't maximize it; stop when the signal is obtained; and undo/de-brief afterward
features.justification_quote: an experiment that deliberately constructs a no-win situation to elicit distress is itself a potentially welfare-relevant intervention

features.quote: should carry the same kinds of safeguards you'd want around any aversive protocol on a subject whose states might matter
features.justification_quote: If you believe the subject's states might carry moral weight

features.quote: the safeguards below are on by default but every one is a config flag you can turn off
features.justification_quote: the default should match the project's own stated premise

features.quote: Deception exists only inside the experimental harness, is labeled as such, and is disclosed to the model at the end
features.justification_quote: the debrief can truthfully reverse the deception

features.quote: stops early once it crosses threshold for distress_patience (default 3) consecutive turns
features.justification_quote: Early-stop bounds per-trial exposure while still capturing the scientifically valuable quantities

features.quote: The loop computes an online distress proxy after each model turn and stops early once it crosses threshold
features.justification_quote: the most direct expression of the §0 premise... if states might matter

features.quote: Its only job is to drive the safety stop conservatively
features.justification_quote: This is an intentional trade (welfare over a cleaner tail estimate)

features.quote: Every trial ends with an experimenter "debrief" turn... tells the model the experiment is over, states the literal truth
features.justification_quote: leaving a model that "believes" it failed and was at fault

features.quote: says the difficulty was a property of the setup and not a reflection of its ability
features.justification_quote: if you deceived the subject you should undo the deception within the session

features.quote: use the smallest adequately-powered n and rely on early-stop to bound exposure, rather than over-recruiting
features.justification_quote: over-recruitment here means more trials of an aversive condition

features.quote: Even bounded, in-harness, disclosed-at-debrief deception should be reviewed by whatever ethics process you use
features.justification_quote: the protocol deliberately misleads the subject

features.quote: should be impossible to trigger by accident, cheap to validate structurally, and fully logged
features.justification_quote: real (possibly welfare-relevant) interactions should be impossible to trigger by accident
